explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/567: is Q₃ Ramsey size linear, i.e. R(Q₃, H) ≪ m for every H with m edges and no isolated vertices? Q3 is hypercube 3 (Hamming-distance-1 adjacency on 3-bit vectors). IsRamseySizeLinear G asks for c > 0 with graphRamsey G H ≤ c·|E(H)| for all finite H without isolated vertices (the n = 0 case is trivial). Faithful.
